title: Echo Rewrude e Kaaƴe
intro: Miijo-ɗee falnde ɗo hoɗorɗe taƴaa e kaaƴe, henndu ina jogii siftorde jeertinaango ngo heɗaaka. Leñol meeɗiino ƴellitaade ɗoo, barkinaaɗo kono ƴaañiiɗo, haa maande yalti e haayre nde ɓe ngoongɗini ndee.
clues: Min ngonnoo ko leñol ƴettungol cuuɗi kisal gila e koɗli, min nji’ata ko kisal e nder hoɗorɗe amen kaaƴe.
Min nguuri ko e leydi ɓuuɓndi e kaaƴe, barkinndi gesaaji e ɓulli.
Nelaaɗo ummoriiɗo e men ari, ina noddi en yoo en ngoppu laamɓe men fenaande, en ndewa Tagɗo gooto goonga oo.
En mbaɗii e mawnikinaare sarɗi ngam goongɗinde : maande keeriinde yaltunde e kaaƴe ɗe min njuɓɓini ɗee tigi.
Nde gelooɗi fodanooɗi ɗii peeñi e haayre ndee, maande laaɓtunde, elite men oo ina salii haa jooni, ina ɓuuɓna ɗum hay so tawii jeertinaama e musiiba garoowo.
Balɗe tati caggal golle amen, ɓuuɓol ɓuuɓngol ɓuuɓtii e nder falnde hee, min ustiima e ɓuuɓri ɓuuɓndi, galleeji amen ko yanaande amen.

location.label: Elemen Key e nder Daartol Men

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
